faq.title: FAQ
faq.lead: Editable in lib/config/appContent.ts — or load from indexer announcements later.
faq.a1: A Bun monorepo scaffold: Solid dApp, Foundry, bponder indexer, and Bun jobs — with user + admin shells.
faq.a2: By default through same-origin /api/rpc on the indexer (method allow-list + rate limit). Set VITE_USE_RPC_PROXY=0 to hit Anvil directly.
faq.q3: How do I extend the home entries?
faq.a3: Edit HOME_FEATURES in appContent.ts and add matching routes under routes/(app).
faq.a4: No — it is only a smoke demo on Home / Debug. Replace with your product contracts.
